# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in results from Extinct and Extant simulations:

```{r load-results}
new_models <- c("BA26B1", "BA26B2", "BA26B3", "BA26B4")

best_models <- readRDS("Outputs/A/best_models.rds")

extinct_results <- readRDS("Outputs/B/Extinct/accuracy_results.rds") %>%
  mutate(model_class = case_when(
    model %in% new_models ~ "New",
    model %notin% new_models & model %in% best_models ~ "Best",
    model %notin% new_models & model %notin% best_models ~ "Old"
  ))
extant_results <- readRDS("Outputs/B/Extant/accuracy_results.rds") %>%
  mutate(model_class = case_when(
    model %in% new_models ~ "New",
    model %notin% new_models & model %in% best_models ~ "Best",
    model %notin% new_models & model %notin% best_models ~ "Old"
  ))
```

Re-specify relevant parameters used in simulations:

```{r parameters}
beta <- 0.2
```

# Comparison

```{r comparison}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
extinct_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = extinct_results,
    aes(
      x = extinction_time, y = threshold,
      group = model, colour = model_class, alpha = model_class
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 150)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "New" = "blue", "Best" = "green3", "Old" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(
    "New" = 1, "Best" = 0.1, "Old" = 0.1)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "A) Extinct",
    x = paste0("Extinction Time"),
    y = paste0("Time to Achieve ", (1 - beta) * 100, "% Power")
  )

extant_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = extant_results,
    aes(
      x = test_time, y = t1_error_rate,
      group = model, colour = model_class, alpha = model_class
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "New" = "blue", "Best" = "green3", "Old" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(
    "New" = 1, "Best" = 0.1, "Old" = 0.1)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "B) Extant",
    x = paste0("Duration of Sighting Record"),
    y = "Type I Error Rate"
  )

all_plot <- ggarrange(extinct_plot, extant_plot, ncol = 2)
ggsave("Figure3.svg", all_plot, width = 9, height = 4.5)
all_plot
```
